checks.purpose: Enforce frontend unit behavior and the configured coverage floor.
checks.triage: Run `cd frontend && npm run test:coverage` and inspect failing tests or thresholds.

checks.purpose: Build the synthetic merge result and detect integration-only frontend failures.
checks.triage: Update the branch, reproduce the merge candidate build, and inspect Vite output.

checks.purpose: Enforce Ruff, mypy, and suppression-budget contracts.
checks.triage: Run `./scripts/riskhub.sh lint` and isolate Ruff, mypy, or suppression output.

checks.purpose: Enforce frontend lint/type/build and repository, documentation, and policy contracts.
checks.triage: Run the named failing command from `lint.yml`; repair the source contract rather than bypassing it.

checks.purpose: Run the default fast backend regression contract on SQLite.
checks.triage: Run `make -f scripts/Makefile test` and inspect the first attributable failure.

checks.purpose: Verify migrations, locking, constraints, and PostgreSQL-specific behavior.
checks.triage: Run `make -f scripts/Makefile test-postgres-ci` against the dedicated test database.

checks.purpose: Decide whether the changed paths require the desktop Playwright suite.
checks.triage: Inspect the changed-path base and the classifier output.

checks.purpose: Run one isolated serial quarter of the desktop Playwright suite.
checks.triage: Download the failing shard artifacts and reproduce the named tests against the guarded test database.

checks.purpose: Require successful shards and verify accessibility execution across their reports.
checks.triage: Open the failing shard, download its Playwright artifacts, and reproduce only the named tests with `./scripts/riskhub.sh e2e`.

checks.purpose: Verify production-profile startup, headers, SSO configuration, Redis, and disabled docs.
checks.triage: Inspect `prod-smoke-backend.log` and reproduce the production-profile environment.

checks.purpose: Provide the protected pull-request check for the public Docker onboarding path.
checks.triage: Download `startup-smoke-pr`, inspect Compose/service logs, and reproduce the PR-head onboarding path.

checks.purpose: Verify the public Docker onboarding path on pushes, schedule, and manual dispatch.
checks.triage: Download `startup-smoke`, inspect Compose/service logs, and run the canonical onboarding path.

checks.purpose: Prevent tracked privacy, path, and public-repository hygiene regressions.
checks.triage: Run `make -f scripts/Makefile public-repo-hygiene` and inspect the exact offending path.

checks.purpose: Enforce immutable action, service-image, and scanner references plus repository hardening invariants.
checks.triage: Run the workflow-pin and repository-hardening validators and repair the mutable reference.

checks.purpose: Prevent authorization and capability-contract drift.
checks.triage: Run the authorization-capability validator and reconcile both contract mirrors.

checks.purpose: Block high-severity Python SAST findings and unaccepted dependency vulnerabilities.
checks.triage: Download Bandit and pip-audit JSON and separate source findings from dependency findings.

checks.purpose: Block high-severity vulnerabilities in the frontend dependency graph.
checks.triage: Run `cd frontend && npm audit --audit-level=high` and inspect the dependency path.

checks.purpose: Enforce locale parity and prevent hardcoded user-facing strings.
checks.triage: Run `cd frontend && npm run i18n:test` and repair the reported key or string.

checks.purpose: Exercise scheduled Redis failure and recovery behavior without blocking pull requests.
checks.triage: Inspect the scheduled pytest artifact and reproduce the Redis integration marker locally.

checks.purpose: Evaluate built backend/frontend images and correlate backend SBOM vulnerabilities.
checks.triage: Download container reports and distinguish frontend Trivy, backend Grype, and scanner-infrastructure outcomes.

checks.purpose: Detect committed credentials and other secret material across repository history.
checks.triage: Inspect the exact fingerprint; remove and rotate genuine secrets or narrowly justify an ignore.

checks.purpose: Verify required response-security headers on pull requests.
checks.triage: Run the security-header tests and inspect middleware/header configuration.

checks.purpose: Enforce documentation topology, production-contract docs, deprecated imports, and ratchet documentation.
checks.triage: Run `make -f scripts/Makefile docs-topology-consistency` and the named failing validator.

checks.purpose: Enforce frontend debt, dead-code, inline-style, and generated-artifact budgets.
checks.triage: Run the debt and cleanup validators and inspect their evidence.

checks.purpose: Report backend lint, type, and suppression drift without acting as a merge gate.
checks.triage: Review Ruff, mypy, and suppression evidence and file owned follow-up work.

checks.purpose: Run low-cost release documentation, pinning, hardening, and deprecated-import contracts on demand.
checks.triage: Run the named contract validator and repair the release-documentation or hardening drift.

checks.purpose: Exercise a reduced release-parity loop on main and schedule without blocking delivery.
checks.triage: Download the parity artifact and inspect startup/dependency fingerprints and the decision record.

checks.purpose: Revalidate immutable workflow and image references before publication.
checks.triage: Run the workflow-pin validator and repair the mutable release dependency.

checks.purpose: Resolve and validate the release version from a tag or manual input.
checks.triage: Inspect the event source and ensure the tag or manual version input is non-empty.

checks.purpose: Run the full release-parity audit and require a GO decision before publication.
checks.triage: Download the parity artifact and inspect `decision.json` and failing evidence.

checks.purpose: Build and publish versioned backend, DB-task, frontend, and Redis images to GHCR.
checks.triage: Inspect GHCR authentication and the first failing image build or push.

checks.purpose: Build the versioned offline Linux installation bundle.
checks.triage: Run the Linux bundle builder with the same version and inspect manifest/build output.

checks.purpose: Verify bundle contents, offline installation, rendered services, nginx, and deploy dry-run behavior.
checks.triage: Download the bundle and reproduce the failing content, install, render, or dry-run assertion.

checks.purpose: Publish tag-backed release notes and attach the verified Linux bundle.
checks.triage: Verify the changelog section, tag ref, downloaded bundle, and release action output.

checks.purpose: Prove that the production frontend container gate rejects an injected qualifying CRITICAL Trivy finding.
checks.triage: Download `frontend-container-injected-finding-evidence`, inspect its SARIF and status JSON, then run the frontend gate validator and focused contract tests.

checks.purpose: Regenerate the exact Python 3.13 development lock on main and open a refresh pull request only when resolver output changes.
checks.triage: Confirm RISKHUB_AUTOMATION_PR_TOKEN has Contents and Pull requests write access, then inspect the permission preflight, resolver output, and change detection.

checks.purpose: Bind reviewed source artifacts to the exact PR head and tree without publishing credentials.
checks.triage: Compare the source artifact commit/tree with the current PR head.

checks.purpose: Exercise identity authority, lifecycle and session regressions against PostgreSQL.
checks.triage: Inspect the first failing identity test and rerun with a disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL.

checks.job_name: Native identity PostgreSQL and Redis regression
checks.purpose: Verify native credentials, MFA, recovery, real TLS mail, Redis limits and independent PostgreSQL races.
checks.triage: Inspect native-regression.log and identity-regression.log for the exact candidate; skips are not backend evidence.

checks.job_name: Native generated-type and frontend build compatibility
checks.purpose: Check native API declaration compatibility with the existing frontend build.
checks.triage: Reproduce npm ci and npm run build against the tested head; this is not a new native UI journey.
